scope: Generated dry midsummer leaf physical-data textures used by NewTown/FoliageTransmission

physicalRationale.normalSignal: The generated leaf profile combines periodic cellular noise and analytic vein structure, then the foliage shader applies _NormalScale=0.72. Compression must not quantize the tangent-space direction before grazing-light evidence is captured.
physicalRationale.smoothnessSignal: The generator encodes dry dielectric leaf smoothness in alpha and NewTown/FoliageTransmission samples that alpha before applying a bounded 0.23-0.24 smoothness scale. Preserve alpha precision; do not infer metallic response from the red channel.
physicalRationale.metallicModel: Living leaves are dielectric; the custom shader uses _DielectricF0=0.03 and does not use metallic reflectance.
physicalRationale.angularResponse: GGX direct specular with Schlick Fresnel; no highlight may be painted into albedo.
physicalRationale.albedoCompressionPolicy: Leaf albedo remains outside this lossless physical-data gate because silhouette coverage is analytic geometry/shader coverage rather than albedo alpha. This gate intentionally targets normal and smoothness precision.

requiredVisualEvidenceWhenRuntimeAvailab: temporal subpixel/grazing sequence for leaf shimmer and mip stability
failureInjection: set either leaf normal or smoothness texture to CompressedHQ
change filter mode to Bilinear or Point
enable sRGB on a physical-data texture
change a normal map away from NormalMap texture type
discard/ignore source alpha on a smoothness texture
